title: Mahakaleshwar — The Lord of Time
intro: In Ujjain, the lingam faces south — the only one of its kind, guarding the city of time itself.

provenance.work: Dwadasha Jyotirlinga Stotram (third verse) + Shivapurana Tantrika tradition of Mahakala
provenance.source: Traditional stotram compilations; Purana references via GRETIL-registered texts

segments.transliteration: avantikāyāṁ vihitāvatāraḥ — in Avantika (Ujjain), the lord descended.
segments.bhava: Draft pending — a five-year-old boy's devotion that stopped death itself at the temple door.

teaser: A child named Shrikhar had nothing but a bent nail and burning faith...
